ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda pre-encryption Safe-Mode reboot + recovery-inhibition chain
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Qilin (aka Agenda) ransomware staging chain executed minutes before the encryptor fires: bcdedit flips the host into Safe Mode (where most AV/EDR don't load), shadow copies are wiped via vssadmin, the backup catalog is wiped via wbadmin, and Windows recovery is disabled via bcdedit. Seeing two or more of these on one host within ~10 minutes is a near-certain detonation precursor for Qilin's affiliate playbook.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as chain values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND Processes.process="*safeboot*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete catalog*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user span=10m _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval chain_count=mvcount(chain) | where chain_count>=2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 1d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Action = case(
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot", "bcd_safeboot",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"), "bcd_disable_recovery",
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows", "vss_wipe",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "catalog", "wbadmin_wipe",
    "")
| where Action != ""
| summarize ChainActions = make_set(Action),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
  by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where array_length(ChainActions) >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 1d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Action = case(
    NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "safeboot", "bcd_safeboot",
    NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"), "bcd_disable_recovery",
    NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadows", "vss_wipe",
    NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "catalog", "wbadmin_wipe",
    "")
| where Action != ""
| summarize ChainActions = make_set(Action),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)
  by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where array_length(ChainActions) >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Pre-Encryption Recovery Inhibition Chain
id: 6e1f4a5d-2b3c-4e8f-9a1d-7c5e3b2a1f6e
status: experimental
description: Detects components of the Qilin (aka Agenda) ransomware staging chain - Safe-Mode boot flip, shadow-copy deletion, backup-catalog wipe, recovery disablement.
references:
  - https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/security-operations/qilin-ransomware
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1489
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  bcdedit_safeboot:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'safeboot'
  bcdedit_recovery:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  vssadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  wbadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  condition: 1 of them
falsepositives:
  - Authorized backup-pruning or DR test windows (correlate with change tickets)
  - IT-led Safe Mode troubleshooting on a single host
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 -@SubjectUserName:*$ ((@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *recoveryenabled* OR *RECOVERYENABLED* OR *bootstatuspolicy* OR *BOOTSTATUSPOLICY*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"Delete Catalog"* OR *"DELETE CATALOG"*)))
ucs.rationale: Qilin/Agenda affiliates have repeatedly executed this exact sequence (per Sophos X-Ops, Group-IB, and Trend Micro reporting on the Agenda/Qilin Rust+Go encryptor): bcdedit flips the box into Safe Mode (the encryptor binary runs as a service in Safe-Mode-with-Networking, T1562.009 - rare among ransomware crews), then vssadmin+wbadmin+bcdedit recovery wipes are issued within seconds of each other. ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin IPScanner.ps1 - Chrome/Edge credential dumper deployed via GPO logon script
ucs.description: Hunts the Sophos-reported Qilin tradecraft of pushing a PowerShell credential-harvester (IPScanner.ps1 / logon.bat wrapper) through Group Policy so it runs at every domain user logon as gpscript.exe -> powershell.exe and then siphons Chrome/Edge/Firefox credential stores. The parent=gpscript.exe + browser-credential-file access combination is unique to this Qilin technique - normal GPO scripts don't touch browser User Data folders.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as scriptStart from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name=gpscript.exe Processes.process_name IN (powershell.exe, pwsh.exe, cmd.exe, wscript.exe, cscript.exe) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_id Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_id AS script_pid process AS script_cmd | join type=inner dest script_pid [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name IN (powershell.exe,pwsh.exe,cmd.exe,wscript.exe,cscript.exe) (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles\\*") (Filesystem.file_name IN ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data","key4.db","logins.json")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename process_id AS script_pid file_name AS browser_file file_path AS browser_path action AS file_action ] | table scriptStart dest user script_cmd browser_file browser_path file_action | sort - scriptStart
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let LogonScripts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ScriptStart=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ScriptPid=ProcessId, ScriptCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where (FolderPath has @"Google\Chrome\User Data"
      or FolderPath has @"Microsoft\Edge\User Data"
      or FolderPath has @"Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles")
| where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data","key4.db","logins.json")
| join kind=inner LogonScripts on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ScriptPid
| where Timestamp between (ScriptStart .. ScriptStart + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, BrowserFile=FileName, BrowserPath=FolderPath, ActionType, ScriptCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\gpscript.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\powershell.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith @"\pwsh.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith @"\cmd.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith @"\wscript.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith @"\cscript.exe"
| extend SuspiciousCmd = iff(
        CommandLine has_any ("Google\\Chrome","Edge\\User Data","Mozilla\\Firefox",
                             "Login Data","Local State","DPAPI","CryptUnprotect",
                             "encrypted_key","IPScanner","FromBase64String",
                             "-enc ","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString"),
        "high","medium")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, SuspiciousCmd
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: PowerShell/Script-Host Spawned by GPO Logon Engine (Qilin IPScanner Pattern)
id: 8e2f3a6c-1c4d-4f9a-bb20-3a6f5d4e2b87
status: experimental
description: Detects script interpreters launched as children of gpscript.exe - the pattern Qilin used to deploy the IPScanner.ps1 Chrome credential harvester through Group Policy.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1037.001
  - attack.t1484.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT-deployed GPO logon/startup scripts - baseline these and allowlist by script name/hash
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/gpscript\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=FileWritten
    | regex("(Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data|Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\User Data|Mozilla\\\\Firefox\\\\Profiles)", field=TargetFileName)
    OR regex("(Login Data|Local State|Cookies|Web Data|key4\\.db|logins\\.json)", field=TargetFileName)
  }, field=[aid, ContextProcessId], include=[TargetFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Documented in Sophos X-Ops' Qilin reporting as a fingerprintable Qilin affiliate technique: after compromising a DC, the operator pushes an IPScanner.ps1 + logon.bat pair through a GPO so every domain user runs the dumper at next interactive logon. gpscript.exe is the Windows binary that executes GPO logon/startup scripts, and the parent->child chain gpscript.exe -> powershell.exe touching Chrome/
